lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately equidistant high-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and lower luminance on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 high-luminance blobs contained within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin.
